attributes.name: section heading structure
attributes.definition: How headings are used to label and divide content sections on the page.

values.definition: Sub-headings are folded into the main content block instead of being separate large heading sections.
A distinct heading label is added to a previously unlabeled block.
A heading is paired with an adjacent link in the section header row.
Headings are treated in some other way or not present.

attributes.name: section header link treatment
attributes.definition: Whether and how a link accompanies or colours a section header.

values.definition: A blue text link ending in an arrow sits beside the heading.
The heading or its link is coloured blue without an arrow.
The section header has no accompanying link.
